title: Length bound for gate-shifting iterations
statement: Fix an input width $n$. For any bit strings $M,w$ and any $i\in\mathbb{N}$, iterating the gate-shifting step $i$ times from the encoded state containing $M$, $w$, and an empty output produces bit strings $w'$ and $out'$ such that the resulting state encodes $M,w',out'$, and $|w'|+|out'|\le |w|+i(2|M|+8)$.
